fact: ZIMSTAT announced it had published the Vital Statistics Report 2023-2024, compiled from Civil Registry Department registrations, covering registered births, deaths, marriages and divorces for 2023 and 2024.

ZIMSTAT published the Vital Statistics Report 2023-2024 on registered births and deaths (including causes of death) for 2023 and 2024, compiled by the Civil Registry Department and processed by ZIMSTAT.
